purpose: Correct M2 evaluation; run the complete two-factor ablation; decide whether M3 is justified from the corrected evidence.
folds: Original 21 leave-one-domain-out development folds; never pool folds for parameter selection.
source_labels: Exactly the frozen C00/P07/P02 source keys, at most 1000 per fold. Cross-fitting only partitions these keys; it never replenishes quotas. Calibration uses only permitted non-support keys.

groups.Base: Frozen C00_original GPR and its original fold-local selected source_only mode.
groups.Base+M1: Frozen P07_pls_concat package including pruning, PLS bypass and its fold-local selected support mode.
groups.Base+M2: Same calibration, support correction and physical expert fusion applied to frozen C00_original.
groups.Base+M1+M2: Identical M2 applied to frozen P07_pls_concat.

m2.calibrator: Increasing isotonic regression on two-fold source-cell cross-fitted predictions and permitted source labels only.
m2.source_folds: Deterministic seeded random balanced partitions within source domains; each cell is held out once.
m2.selection: Within each outer fold: select alpha/beta by validation macro MAE, RMSE, P95; freeze A; select A/B weight on the same fold's validation cells; then score the outer fold once.
m2.physical_branch: Frozen P02_anchor_physics. Always use GPModel.predict so source anchoring is included.

seed_meaning: Source-cell cross-fit partitions vary. Frozen GPR controls are deterministic; duplicate control predictions are not independent random training runs.
selection_boundary: Training gets only permitted source labels. Validation gets only this fold's validation query labels. Inference gets target first K labels and current query signal. Scoring alone reads outer query labels.
aggregation: Compute MAE/RMSE/P95 per cell first, then mean within domain, then equal-domain mean within dataset. A macro mean of cell P95 values is not the pooled 95% quantile.
audits: saved query predictions and exact recomputation
frozen base and physical prediction reproduction
decision: Report failures honestly. M2 is supported only if the full model consistently improves all three metrics on all three datasets, with paired uncertainty and full four-group evidence. Defer M3 if M2 fails or is not independently useful.
limits: Development datasets have already informed architecture exploration; this run does not restore untouched final-test status.
M1 is the existing package, not a pure PLS-only causal intervention. A new-feature-only claim requires matched pruning/adaptation controls.
No locked external datasets are used in this correction.
